description: Pysewer builds connected sewer layouts from roads, buildings and elevation, sizes pipes using dry-weather flow, and adds lifting or pumping where gravity flow is insufficient. The release records changes during JOSS review. This resource is provided by Sanne, Moritz; Khurelbaatar, Ganbaatar; Despot, Daneish and coauthors. Its method is not tied to one place; geographic inputs and simulation resolution depend on the user configuration. The provider lists ZIP formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: GPL-3.0-or-later. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The lowest terrain point is the default treatment-plant location; demand and population assumptions must be replaced where local evidence differs. For simulation, it can support model preparation or execution. Related catalogue record: model-iwa-benchmark-simulation-models. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
